web.title: When overtime applies - Fair Work Ombudsman
web.description:
# When overtime applies
## When overtime rates apply
An award, enterprise agreement, other [registered agreementA document between an employer and their employees covering employment conditions. A registered agreement must be approved by and registered with the Fair Work Commission. Examples of registered agreements include enterprise agreements (including single and multi-enterprise) and greenfields agreements.](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/taxonomy/term/407) or employment contract can set out when an employee can be required to work overtime and when overtime rates apply.

web.title: Award and agreement free wages and conditions - Fair Work Ombudsman
web.description:
# Award and agreement free wages and conditions
## Hours of work, breaks and overtime
### When overtime applies
Award and agreement free employees don’t get a higher pay rate when they work overtime hours, unless their employment contract says so.

web.description:
# Pay, entitlements and working conditions
## Getting paid
### Minimum pay rates
#### Not covered by an award or registered agreement
This is the minimum pay rate provided by the Fair Work Act 2009 and is reviewed each year.

### Penalty rates and allowances
#### **![](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/sites/default/files/2022-08/yw-example-icon.png)Example: Penalty rates**
Tunde is covered by the Fast Food Award. Under the award, she is entitled to penalty rates for working on a Saturday and for working between 10pm and midnight.

web.title: Penalty rates - Fair Work Ombudsman
web.description:
# Penalty rates
## Calculating penalty rates
The penalty rates that you or your employees are entitled to will depend on the award that applies.

If you're covered by an enterprise agreement or other [registered agreementA document between an employer and their employees covering employment conditions. A registered agreement must be approved by and registered with the Fair Work Commission. Examples of registered agreements include enterprise agreements (including single and multi-enterprise) and greenfields agreements.](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/taxonomy/term/407), your penalty rates will be in your agreement.

## Related information
- [Overtime pay](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/penalty-rates-allowances-and-other-payments/overtime-pay)

# List of awards
## How awards apply
Awards don’t apply when an employer has an enterprise agreement or other [registered agreementA document between an employer and their employees covering employment conditions. A registered agreement must be approved by and registered with the Fair Work Commission. Examples of registered agreements include enterprise agreements (including single and multi-enterprise) and greenfields agreements.](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/taxonomy/term/407) and the employee is covered by it.
